great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: The eligible Room Rent or Room Category applicable for the Insured Person under the Policy is 'No limit', which means that there is no separate restriction on Room Charges incurred towards stay during Hospitalization
great.explanation: You can choose any room category without a room-rent cap triggering proportionate deductions. This means no limit on room rent charges during hospitalization.

great.name: ICU Charges
great.quote: Intensive Care Unit Charges (ICU Charges): The eligible ICU Charges applicable for the Insured Person under the Policy is 'No limit'
great.explanation: There is no separate sub-limit on ICU charges, so ICU expenses are covered fully within the sum insured.

great.name: No Claim Bonus
great.quote: At the end of each Policy Year, the Company will enhance the Sum Insured by 50% flat... (i) ...shall not exceed 100% of the Sum Insured... (vi) In the event of a Claim there is no impact on the accrual of Cumulative Bonus.
great.explanation: Your sum insured increases by 50% each year up to double the base amount, and this bonus does not reduce even if you make a claim.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: automatically make the re-instatement of up to the base Sum Insured unlimited times in a policy year... (iii) Recharge amount can be utilized for same illness as well as different Illnesses.
great.explanation: The policy restores your sum insured unlimited times per year after exhaustion, including for the same illness, giving you extra coverage.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: The Recharge shall be utilized only after the base Sum Insured, applicable Cumulative Bonus , Cumulative Bonus Super (if applicable) and Plus Benefit (if applicable) have been completely exhausted in that Policy Year.
great.explanation: Extra sum insured protection activates only after you fully use your base sum insured and bonuses, providing additional financial safety.

great.name: Modern Treatments
great.quote: Advance Technology Methods: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person up to the Sum Insured... for treatment taken through following advance technology methods: ... Robotic surgeries ... Immunotherapy ... Oral chemotherapy ...
great.explanation: Several advanced treatment methods like robotic surgery and immunotherapy are covered within the sum insured, ensuring access to modern care.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED)... shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 36 months from policy start, which is a standard waiting period in the market.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/ treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage...
good.explanation: Coverage for specified illnesses starts after 24 months, which aligns with typical market practice.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered during the first 30 days except accidents, which is a common initial waiting period.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: For a period of 60 days immediately prior to the Insured Person's date of admission to the Hospital
good.explanation: Expenses incurred up to 60 days before hospitalization are covered, providing good pre-hospitalization support.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: For a period of 180 days immediately after the Insured Person's date of discharge from the hospital
good.explanation: Expenses up to 180 days after discharge are covered, which is a generous post-hospitalization period.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Any item or condition or treatment specified in List of Non-Medical Items (Annexure  I to Policy Terms & Conditions).
bad.reference: Clause 4.2(1) Specific Exclusions + Annexure I (Non-medical items list includes e.g. "Gloves", "Mask", "Nebulisation Kit")
bad.explanation: Common hospital consumables and non-medical items are excluded by default, causing out-of-pocket expenses unless you opt for an additional benefit.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote: For diseases or conditions or procedure that have a specified sub-limit... For example- if the Policy specifies a sub-limit of Rs. 50,000 for a particular disease then all expenses related to the treatment of that disease... will be covered up to Rs. 50,000
bad.explanation: The policy may impose rupee limits on specific diseases, which reduces coverage for those conditions and can increase your costs.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: The Co-payment proportion ( If opted ) shall be borne by the Insured Person on each Claim...
bad.reference: General Conditions Applicable To All The Benefits And Optional Benefits, point 4; also Clause 3.2.7 (Co-payment Optional Benefit)
bad.explanation: Co-pay applies only if chosen as an optional benefit, but the base plan's default co-pay percentage is not clearly stated, so check your policy schedule for details.
